rules: Interpret the requested intention and function before consulting registries or indexes.
Route additions into the existing logical location instead of rebuilding the host architecture.
Classify additions as autonomous app, integrated module, utility service, or admin access before placement.
Indexes, cadastres and registries are evidence/catalogue layers; they do not drive interpretation.
GThink is the component that interprets blob signals and produces the response; blobs carry structure, state and data.
When information is missing, request or load only the branch needed for the active task rather than loading the full blob.
